fit.sheet: onsemi BC546/BC547/BC548/BC549/BC550 data sheet, Rev. 2 (April 2021, BC550/D)
fit.figure: Figure 3. DC Current Gain (VCE = 5 V; one typical curve for every type and grade); Figure 2. Transfer Characteristics (IC against VBE, VCE = 5 V; read as VBE(on) against IC), moved -15.3 mV onto the table's 660 mV typical at 2 mA (the figure reads 0.727 V at 10 mA, above the table's 720 mV maximum); Figure 4. Collector-Emitter Saturation Voltage (IC = 10 IB); Electrical Characteristics: Cib 9 pF typical at VEB = 0.5 V (the sheet draws no Cib curve: one point sets CJE, with ngspice's default VJE 0.75 V and MJE 0.33); Figure 5. Output Capacitance (Cob, IE = 0, f = 1 MHz), times 1.620 onto the table's 3.5 pF typical at VCB = 10 V (the figure reads 2.16 pF there); Electrical Characteristics: fT 300 MHz typical at IC = 10 mA, VCE = 5 V (Figure 6 reads 294 MHz there); VCB = 5 V less VBE 0.73 V from Figure 2
fit.method: Gummel-Poon (scripts/fit_models.py). IS, NF, BF, ISE, NE, IKF, NKF and RE by least squares on the hFE and VBE(on) curves at VCE = 5 V together (points: the curves read at 1-2-5 steps; the hFE curve times 2.898, see note); no Early voltage (VAF left out): the sheet gives no output admittance, and its Figure 1 output curves disagree with each other (IB = 50 µA flat from 5 to 15 V; 100 µA rising 0.28 mA/V; 150 µA 0.15 mA/V), so none is set (ngspice's default). BR, ISC, NC and RC by least squares on the VCE(sat) curve, the hFE points held, NR = NF, at IC/IB = 10. CJE, VJE, MJE from Cibo and CJC, VJC, MJC from Cobo against reverse voltage. TF from fT 300 MHz at 10 mA (Electrical Characteristics: fT 300 MHz typical at IC = 10 mA, VCE = 5 V (Figure 6 reads 294 MHz there); VCB = 5 V less VBE 0.73 V from Figure 2), less the junctions' charging time. Fitted curves are matched within 1.8 % (hFE), 3.4 mV (VBE) and 2.2 mV (VCE(sat)). RB, VAR, TR and the temperature terms are ngspice's defaults: the sheet doesn't pin them
fit.note: The sheet draws one typical gain curve for the whole BC546-BC550 family (200 at 2 mA, flat from 1 to 20 mA) and doesn't say which grade it is drawn for (200 sits where its groups A, 110-220, and B, 200-450, meet). Its shape is kept and its level set to the geometric middle of this part's 2 mA range (gain group C: 420 to 800, so 580), as for the 2N5088/89 (D-161, D-163). The curve is drawn from 1 mA only, so below 1 mA the gain follows from the VBE(on) curve and the model's leakage term alone
